title: AI-Powered Indian Sign Language (ISL) Detection and Translation
summary: The International Institute of Information Technology, Hyderabad, is building a proof-of-concept AI system to recognize and translate Indian Sign Language; no test with signers is reported.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: In a project account for the International Telecommunication Union, current as of June 2025, the International Institute of Information Technology, Hyderabad, described a system under development to recognize and translate Indian Sign Language. The account gives the status of the use case as "In Development (PoC Stage)". Communication and education benefits remain prospective. No source reports that the system was tested with signers or used in a school or service.
purpose: Translate Indian Sign Language into accessible spoken or written communication.
system: Indian Sign Language detection and translation system
developer: International Institute of Information Technology, Hyderabad
